## EA Practice Documentation Platform and Authoring Strategy

**← Back to [EAP Home](../README.md) • [Foundation](./README.md)**

---

> This document defines Gainwell's Reference Architecture strategy, outlining the approach to managing enterprise architecture documentation, knowledge, and artifacts through modern code-based methodologies. It establishes the technical foundation for the documentation platform and describes the multi-tiered authoring strategy to accommodate diverse contributor needs across the enterprise architecture practice.

### 1.1 Strategic Intent

**Architecture as Code**: Gainwell transforms enterprise architecture from static documentation into a living, automated knowledge ecosystem using modern software development practices.
page_texts.6:
[foundation/reference-architecture.md#12-core-principles]

### 1.2 Core Principles

**Everything as Code** - Documentation, diagrams, standards, and policies managed through version-controlled repositories with automated quality gates.

**Single Source of Truth** - GitHub repository serves as the authoritative source with seamless integration from enterprise systems.

**Progressive Authoring** - Multi-tiered contribution pathways accommodate technical experts, business users, and executive stakeholders.

**AI-Enhanced Discovery** - Conversational search capabilities provide instant access to contextual architecture knowledge.

page_texts.15:
[foundation/reference-architecture.md#search-quality--performance]

#### **Search Quality & Performance**

The ARIA Search integration provides enterprise-grade search capabilities with the following characteristics:

- **Hybrid Search Strategy**: Combines vector similarity (semantic) with lexical matching (keyword) for optimal relevance
- **Contextual Chunking**: Intelligent document segmentation preserves context while enabling precise retrieval
- **Relevance Tuning**: Continuously optimized scoring algorithms for architecture-specific content
- **Performance Metrics**: <500ms average response time, 99.9% availability, scalable to 1000+ concurrent users
page_texts.16:
[foundation/reference-architecture.md#integration-with-mkdocs-platform]

#### **Integration with MkDocs Platform**

The ARIA Search service integrates seamlessly with the MkDocs documentation platform through a shared Network Load Balancer (NLB) configuration:

- **Unified Access**: Single domain serves both static documentation and AI search API
- **Cross-Platform Navigation**: Search results link directly to MkDocs pages
- **Consistent Authentication**: Shared authentication layer across both services
- **Performance Optimization**: CDN acceleration for both static content and API responses

[foundation/reference-architecture.md#intelligent-documentation-search-architecture]

### Intelligent Documentation Search Architecture

The Reference Architecture platform features **ARIA Search** - a sophisticated AI-powered search capability built on RAG architecture using AWS Bedrock and OpenSearch for conversational, context-aware search across the documentation ecosystem.

**Key Capabilities:**

- **Natural Language Processing**: Understands conversational queries with domain-specific intelligence
- **Source Attribution**: Every response includes specific document citations with direct links
- **Real-Time Indexing**: Automatically processes new documentation as it's added
- **Enterprise Integration**: Secure access with audit compliance and sub-second response times

**Technical Implementation:**

| Component           | Technology                       | Purpose                                                |
| ------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| **AI/ML Platform**  | AWS Bedrock (Claude 4.0+ Sonnet) | Natural language understanding and response generation |
| **Vector Database** | OpenSearch                       | Semantic search with hybrid lexical matching           |
| **API Framework**   | FastAPI on EKS                   | High-performance microservice architecture             |

page_texts.28:
[foundation/reference-architecture.md#external-customer-export-formats]

#### **External Customer Export Formats**

For external customer deliverables and stakeholder consumption, architecture artifacts can be exported in industry-standard formats:

| Content Type | Primary Export Format | Alternative Format (if required) | Notes |
| ------------ | --------------------- | -------------------------------- | ----- |
| **Documentation** | PDF | Word (.docx) | Markdown converted to PDF; Word conversion available upon request |
| **Diagrams** | SVG | Visio (.vsdx) | SVG is vector-based and scales without quality loss; Visio conversion available if explicitly required |

> **⚠️ Intellectual Property Protection**: _It is strongly recommended to export diagrams as SVG (or other image formats) to protect intellectual property. Editable formats (draw.io, Visio) should only be provided when explicitly required and approved, as they expose design methodologies and proprietary architecture patterns._

**Export Capabilities**:

- **Diagrams → SVG**: Primary export format for all visual diagrams; SVG is vector-based and scales infinitely without quality loss while protecting IP
- **draw.io ↔ Visio**: draw.io supports Visio (.vsdx) import/export, available only when customer explicitly requires editable format
- **Markdown → PDF/Word**: Documentation can be exported to PDF via MkDocs, or converted to Word format using pandoc when required

[foundation/reference-architecture.md#competitive-differentiation]

#### **Competitive Differentiation**

The Reference Architecture strategy provides significant advantages over traditional documentation platforms including LeanIX, developer portal solutions (such as Backstage), Sparx Enterprise Architect, Confluence, and Notion.

**Key Strategic Differentiators:**

- **Hybrid Multi-Tiered Approach**: Only solution combining EA management with developer-grade documentation practices
- **Future-Proof Architecture**: Git-based foundation ensures long-term viability and tool flexibility
- **AI Integration**: Purpose-built RAG search for architecture content vs. generic AI features
- **Open Standards**: Minimal vendor lock-in through portable formats and technologies

**Industry Leadership Positioning**

- Modern, transparent architecture practice
- Rapid knowledge sharing and collaboration
- Innovation in documentation and knowledge management
- Open-source community engagement and contribution
- No vendor lock-in through open standards and technologies

**Client and Partner Benefits**

- Transparent architecture documentation for clients
- Rapid onboarding of new team members and partners
- Professional presentation of capabilities and standards
- Evidence-based architecture decisions with full audit trails
